socketCompatibility.title: Real-time connection looks unstable
socketCompatibility.description: This network may not support websocket-only connections. You can enable compatibility mode for a steadier connection, though it may be slightly slower.
socketCompatibility.enabledDescription: Polling fallback is now allowed for real-time updates. If your network becomes normal again, you can turn it off to recover faster response.
socketCompatibility.disabledDescription: Returned to websocket-only mode and reconnecting now.

compatibility.seoDescription: This browser is missing modern CSS features required by the app. Please try the latest Chrome or update Android System WebView.
compatibility.requiredVersions: In practice Chrome 88+, Edge 88+, Android WebView 88+, Safari 14+, and Firefox 78+ are more stable, but lower versions are still allowed when the required capabilities are present.
compatibility.title: This browser is not fully compatible
compatibility.description: This environment is missing critical capabilities that the project does not currently have a safe fallback for. We only block in that case. If the page can still run correctly, a lower browser version alone will not be blocked.
compatibility.reasonRuntimeCore: Core runtime features such as Promise, fetch, or URLSearchParams are missing, so the main app flow cannot be trusted to work.
compatibility.reasonResizeObserver: ResizeObserver is missing, so board sizing and critical layout calculations in gameplay are likely to break.
compatibility.recommendationChrome: Open this page with the latest Chrome, Edge, or another up-to-date browser.
compatibility.recommendationWebView: If this page is opened inside an app, update Android System WebView or open it in an external browser instead.
compatibility.recommendationRetry: After updating the browser or system component, come back and tap “Retry check”.
compatibility.note: Continuing only skips this notice for the current session. It does not fix compatibility.

summonerwars.title: Summoner Wars
summonerwars.description: Summoner Wars is a fast-paced, tactical 2-player game. Players take on the role of Summoners, leading their faction to conquer the war-torn world of Itharia through the power of mysterious Summoning Stones.
